source.source: Kraken public Trades API (SOLUSD), aggregated to 5m candles; completed candles only

assumptions.funded_model_scope: Existing FleetLedgerSim model (candle-close reference plus 0.03% adverse adjustment), separate from conservative reference fills. Does not replay HTTP timing or the new server-side stop-risk recheck; not exact post-fix execution parity.
assumptions.reference: Fixed $10 planned stop risk, unlimited buying power. $1000 is the drawdown denominator, not proof that every reference trade is affordable. Funded simulation is separately reported.
assumptions.costs: 0.20% every fill, plus assumed 0.01% spread and 0.02% slippage per side. Not measured venue spreads. No maker discount.
assumptions.fills: Must trade one tick through the limit. Ambiguous intrabar path follows existing broker emulator. Missing 5m intervals are not fabricated; incomplete higher-timeframe buckets excluded.
assumptions.drawdown: Closed-trade only; intratrade drawdown may be larger. No claim of under 1% drawdown.
assumptions.selection: Highest training net among candidates with >=20 training trades; a negative best result remains a rejection.
